preconditions.description: The sizes of the given permutations are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a[i] <= n for all 1 <= i <= n
preconditions.description: Each integer in permutation a is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= b[i] <= m for all 1 <= i <= m
preconditions.description: Each integer in permutation b is between 1 and m, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in a are distinct.
All elements in b are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of distinct integers d is within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: exists d such that all(c[i] = a[i] + d for i in range(n)) and c is a subsequence of b
postconditions.description: There exists at least one integer d that, when added to each element of permutation a, results in a subsequence of permutation b.
